## Summary

- Replace `prometheus_client` with OpenTelemetry SDK (metrics + traces + logs); `/metrics` Prometheus pull still works; OTLP push enabled via optional `[otlp]` extra + `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT`.
- Add `RequestIdMiddleware` with CRLF-safe `X-Request-ID` handling; JSON application logs carry `request_id`/`trace_id`/`span_id`; audit records carry the same and dual-write to OTel logs when a LoggerProvider is configured.
- Add manual spans around `dispatch_tool`, `bash_execute`, transfer upload/download; saturation gauges for inflight bash processes, token count by role, audit write failures; Grafana dashboard JSON; README "Observability" section with three deployment recipes.

## Test plan

- [x] `pytest tests/ -v --benchmark-disable` — 383 passed, 4 skipped
- [x] `ruff check . && ruff format --check . && mypy src/mymcp` — clean
- [x] Smoke: `mymcp serve` then `curl -H "X-Request-ID: smoke" /health` round-trips header; `/metrics` returns `mymcp_bash_inflight_processes`, `mymcp_tokens_count{role=...}`; JSON logs include `request_id`/`trace_id`/`span_id`.
- [ ] Manual: import `deploy/observability/dashboard.json` in Grafana against a Prometheus data source.
- [ ] Manual: run with `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT` set and verify traces/logs reach the collector.

title: feat(obs): OpenTelemetry three-pillar observability (metrics + traces + logs)
